description:
Track time against threads, billable or not.

Subcommands:
  log THREAD [DESCRIPTION ...] [-m MIN] [-r RATE] [-c CCY] [-d DATE] [-t HH:MM] — append a time entry
  list [THREAD] [--since D] [--until D] [--json] — list entries
  report [--thread T] [--since D] [--until D] [--json] — totals by thread and currency; unbilled time totalled separately
  show ID [--json] — show one entry
  edit ID [--description TEXT ...] [-m MIN] [-r RATE] [-c CCY] [-d DATE] [-t HH:MM] — change fields of an entry
  rm ID -y — permanently delete an entry

Args:
  THREAD, T: a thread name, 'Kind/Name', or wikilink.
  DESCRIPTION: what was done. Keep it to a short invoice line item, not a narrative. Can be one element or several words.
  ID: the entry's 8-char id, from `hours list`.
  D, DATE: YYYY-MM-DD.

Flags:
  log:
    -m / --minutes  duration in minutes (default 60); must be positive
    -r / --rate  hourly rate; 0 means unbillable. Needs a currency
    -c / --currency  ISO code (default: the thread's). With neither, the entry is recorded as unbilled
    -d / --date  YYYY-MM-DD (default today)
    -t / --time  start time HH:MM (default now)
  list, report: --since and --until (inclusive), --json
  show: --json
  edit:
    --description  new description; takes multiple words
    -m / --minutes  new duration; the start time is kept
    -r / --rate  new hourly rate; needs a currency
    -c / --currency  new ISO code
    -d / --date  move the entry to this day; the duration is kept
    -t / --time  move the entry to this start time; the duration is kept
  rm: -y / --yes  required to delete

Examples:
  ["log", "Projects/Northwind", "Spec review", "-m", "90", "-d", "2026-10-20"]
  ["report", "--thread", "Projects/Northwind", "--since", "2026-10-01", "--json"]
  ["edit", "abcd1234", "-m", "45"]
  ["rm", "abcd1234", "-y"]

Notes:
  Nothing prompts.
  Entries live in threads/<Kind>/<Name>/hours.md, which the tool rewrites. Do not edit that file by hand.
  For edit, put ID first: --description consumes every word that follows it.
  Each `log` queues a REF: in the buffer, filed under the day of the work. It reaches the thread's daily log on `buffer flush`.
  Put real content in a log line (`buffer add-text`), not in the description, because hours are not searchable.
  rm is permanent and fails without -y.
  Exit 1: non-positive --minutes, a rate with no currency, or an empty description.
